messages:
eval-bot: nightly-eval alert: promptset v6 (pset_2026_06) -> regression on pset_instruction_follow AUC -6.2%
Anita: saw that, +1 reproducible locally on emu-run.
Ryan: can you paste the exact prompt diff? want to see what changed.
eval-bot: diff snippet:
```diff
- Instruction: "Answer concisely."
+ Instruction: "Be thorough and explain reasoning step-by-step."
```
Sophia: oh that's a pretty big style shift — we intentionally added 'explain reasoning' to reduce terse answers, but that can increase hallucination surface.
Luis: reproducing on rdx-7b-quant: seeing multiple confident-but-wrong answers on factual QA, e.g. geography items.
Anita: minimal repro log:
```
input: "What's the capital of Tasmania?"
gold: "Hobart"
model: "Launceston"
```
Ryan: seems like instruction drift => extra non-grounded generation when asked to elaborate. Could be model tendency amplified by longer output preference.
Sophia: next steps we should consider: (1) revert to v5 prompt (concise) and run nightly again, (2) rebaseline metrics to accept longer answers (but that hides hallucination), (3) craft a hybrid prompt that requests reasoning only when asked.
Anita: my vote is revert short-term and run a controlled canary with v6 on 10% eval traffic to measure delta.
Luis: +1 for canary. Also want a specialized hallucination filter in the eval harness to count ungrounded assertions.
Ryan: I'll open a revert PR for the pset delta and add an experimental prompt variant for the canary. @Sophia can you sign off on rebaseline if canary shows no hallucination increase?
Sophia: will review PR; my tentative rule: allow rebaseline only if hallucination rate <= 1.2x baseline and answer precision doesn't drop. If canary violates, we revert. :thumbsup:
Anita: created PR #4521 -> https://git.internal/redwood/psets/pulls/4521 (revert + experimental variant)
eval-bot: canary run scheduled at 1798726200, will post per-case hallucination counts back to this thread.
Luis: adding a note to the onboarding doc: avoid global style switches in promptset diffs without a phased canary.
Ryan: thanks everyone — I'll follow up with the PR link and quick benchmark summary once CI finishes.
Sophia: thanks — good triage.
